name: uberasm-spawn-sprites-in-yoshi-s-mouth-v1
title: Spawn Sprites in Yoshi's Mouth v1.1
description:
Press L or R to spawn an item in Yoshi's mouth. Works with shells of different colours, Goombas, Springs, P-Switches and Keys. Did not test every other sprites but I don't think anything else works properly. File includes settings at the top to select which sprite to use, timer for Yoshi's swallowing, and sounds.

Based on code posted by Thomas here

Edited to add sounds options.

v1.1 Fixed a bug where you could spawn a null item by pressing R the frame after Y
